title: Modified Qiagen PCR Purification with MinElute Spin Column
author: Daniel J. Richter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ivece3e

steps.title: Prepare PCR Sample
steps.instruction: Add 5 volumes of Buffer PB to the PCR product and mix.

steps.title: Bind DNA to Column
steps.instruction: Load 800 μL of sample into a QIAquick column placed within a collection tube and centrifuge at maximum speed for 1 minute.

substeps.instruction: If any sample remains in the tube, continue spinning through the column and discard the flow-through.

steps.title: Wash Column
steps.instruction: Wash the column with 750 μL of buffer PE and centrifuge for 1 minute, then discard the flow-through.

steps.title: Remove Residual Liquid
steps.instruction: Clean the top and bottom edges of the collection tube by pipetting out any remaining liquid using a P20 pipette.

steps.title: Dry Column Membrane
steps.instruction: Perform two sequential spins to dry the column membrane.

substeps.instruction: Place column with hinge facing INWARDS and spin for 1 minute.
Place column with hinge facing OUTWARDS and spin for 1 minute at maximum speed.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the purified DNA into a new 1.5 μL Eppendorf tube.

substeps.instruction: Place the column in a new 1.5 μL Eppendorf tube.
Centrifuge at maximum speed for 1 minute to elute.
